page.overview:
What is I Don't Want to Spoil the Party?

I Don't Want to Spoil the Party is a song by The Beatles, credited Lennon/McCartney.

Fun Fact John didn't harmonize with himself in the verses. It was Paul singing the low harmony and switching to a high harmony in the bridges.
